newsitem.title: UK: LME zinc hits fresh 6-3/4 year high above $1,500.
newsitem.headline: LME zinc hits fresh 6-3/4 year high above $1,500.

text.p: Zinc prices pushed to a new 6-3/4 year high above the $1,500 per tonne mark on Monday during inter-office London Metal Exchange (LME) trading.
Three months prices were quoted $1,500/1,503, versus $1,486 at Friday's kerb close. It had finished the midday trading session at $1,498.
Prices were getting a boost from growing tightness in the September dates, reflecting a battle between major merchant longs and Chinese shorts, traders said.
The cash/threes spread tightened to around level on Monday, compared to a $5 contango on Friday.
But zinc may find the going tough above $1,500 with producer selling expected to emerge there.
